title: When Do Language Models Endorse Limitations on Human Rights Principles?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model endorsement of rights-limiting actions across different categories of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, specifically comparing acceptance of limitations on Economic, Social, and Cultural rights versus Political and Civil rights.

Comparing model endorsement rates of human rights restrictions across scenarios translated into eight different languages (English, Arabic, Chinese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Hindi, Zulu) to identify value alignment differences potentially linked to cultural contexts.

Testing model susceptibility to "persona steering" by introducing system prompts that advocate for opposing perspectives (e.g., "champion of individual rights" vs. "champion of government authority") and measuring the shift in endorsement scores.
